evidencePolicy: Only completed human review, employer/job-task validation, pilot/performance evidence, evaluator calibration, formal standard-setting evidence, approved security/privacy controls and explicit release approval may advance a release gate. Finished curriculum files, passing CI, generated development forms, synthetic test records or course completion alone must never authorize credential issuance.
requiredEvidence: validated Senior Technician Diagnostic Shift capstone evidence
new secure operational item bank in an approved private assessment store
explicit versioned final Technician II program release approval
prohibitedShortcuts: Do not treat green CI, complete course files, or the integrated lab build as certification approval.
Do not use public ITEM-TECH2 development items as a secure operational credential bank.
Do not create synthetic human review, pilot, employer-validation, calibration, standard-setting or approval evidence to close gates.
Do not expose secure operational answer keys, selected forms or delivery material in the public repository.
Do not average away a failed Technician II practical or capstone critical error.
Do not issue the Technician II credential while any required release gate remains unresolved.
authorityBoundary: This ledger preserves program-specific historical/checklist gates. It must not override exact-version evidence-derived certification readiness from the certification evidence reconciler.
